base: branche de session (EWC1 et ESN1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Old Castle / Chambre Doree (Explorateurs du Ciel), salle de boss / tresor au bout du donjon
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip oldcastlepmd.png passe au generateur ; decor complet et sol complet sans objets edites et recales (0, 0)

reference_da.titre: Old Castle / Chambre Doree (Pokemon Donjon Mystere : Explorateurs du Ciel, oldcastlepmd.png)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Old Castle / Golden Chamber): same golden-beige brick flagstones (#B4A468) with darker aged bronze-gold bricks at the bottom (#8A7846) and bright radiant cream-gold bricks at the top (#EFEFBF), same ornate carved circular sandstone rosette medallion in the center of the floor, same ornate scrolled golden balustrades and golden orb-topped pillars with soft drop shadows, same green-and-silver treasure chests with gold trim. Make a NEW, larger top-down dungeon boss / treasure room map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out so the chamber feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) on the golden-brick walkway between two ornate scrolled golden balustrades and four golden orb-topped pillars; the walkway opens onto a large ornate carved circular rosette medallion in the center of the hall (the boss arena); around the upper/northern arc of the circular medallion, two concentric semicircular arcs of green-and-silver treasure chests frame the medallion, leaving a clear central gap at the top of the medallion that leads to a grand carved golden stone altar / royal pedestal at the north-center flanked by two golden orb-topped pillars, with a solid golden-brick wall/sanctuary closing the northern border (NO doorway, NO portal opening, NO exit). No characters, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.essais: premier essai ; conforme (dalles_claires 9.2, dalles 4.5, bronze 5.2, coffres 7.1)

generation.prompt: Same image, same framing and pixel-art style (1200x896), but remove all green-and-silver treasure chests, all 6 golden orb-topped pillars, both scrolled golden balustrades at the bottom, the golden altar at the top-center, and all their drop shadows, replacing them seamlessly with the surrounding golden-beige brick flagstones; keep the golden-beige brick flagstone floor, the central circular carved rosette medallion, and the top golden brick wall at the exact same pixel positions. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

recalage.zones: sol complet : rosace centrale erodee de 6 px

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne ; seuil 35

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

lueur_autel.origine: halo respirant cree par nous autour de l autel avec uniquement des couleurs exactes du rip oldcastlepmd.png

eclats_or.origine: scintillements crees par nous sur les coffres, l autel et les spheres d or avec uniquement des couleurs exactes du rip

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors praticable (dalles_claires, dalles, rosace, dalles_sombres)
access.sortie: aucune (fin de donjon, bords N/O/E/S fermes hors arrivee sud)
